name: support_routing
description: Port of awesome-jev support-routing: classify a support request into a department via Choice, and ask a separate Noul about explicitly-stated urgency - the two questions are atomic and independent. Code (rules) combines them: department confidence < 0.8 or a pick of `other` routes to human_review; urgency uses the dual-threshold band (>=0.85 high, <=0.15 ordinary, in-between review) rather than a forced yes/no.

department.instructions: Which team should handle the customer's primary request in message? Choose other if unclear or outside the options.

criteria.billing: Invoices, charged amounts, refunds, or payment methods.
criteria.technical: Application failures, outages, or integration bugs.
criteria.account: Login, account access, or account profile changes.
criteria.other: No clear primary request, overlapping requests, or none of the teams fit.

explicit_urgency.instructions: Does message explicitly describe a time-critical operational impact or deadline? Judge the words, not the department.
explicit_urgency.truthy: Explicit deadline or ongoing work blocked by the issue.
explicit_urgency.falsy: No explicit time-critical impact or deadline.
